text: S641 screens publicly documented local, no-cost apparel CAD receivers after S640. Existing evidence already covers CLO 2026.1.310 and Open CAD Studio; no repeated import/export experiment is planned. The research will not install software, upload patterns, contact vendors, spend money, or change V03 acceptance, profile/rights gates, thresholds, or holds. See E-G04-S641-START.
